messages:
Maya (AE): @Priya FYI — HelionTech POC is stuck. CTO wants an executive touchpoint today. Main blockers: BYO-KMS requirement, mTLS for websocket egress, and clarity on short-term pricing for a reserved pool while they validate throughput. Need a one-line summary for the CEO + CTO call.

Jared (SE): Quick repro: when we ramp to ~80–100rps the websocket connection intermittently returns 503 and logs show `tls: handshake failure`. Seen on both TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3. Repro steps and raw logs in the runbook.

Priya (Solutions): I can join the call. Can we offer a temporary Dedicated 4xA100 pool for their pilot? Ballpark cost ~$28k/mo. Proposal: 2-week pilot at 20% of list or a credit, then roll into commited capacity if they sign. @Liam can confirm pricing flexibility.

Liam (Sales Eng): Pricing note — we normally require revops signoff for sub-list trial discounts. 20% is doable for a limited pilot if we get exec buy-in. Need confirmation on whether this is billed as usage or a one-off pilot credit.

Taylor (CSM): I can approve a pilot credit up to $6k today, but need legal to OK the BYO-KMS carve-out. Also need the exact scope (duration, qps guarantee) to document the SLA for the pilot.

Maya (AE): Helion insists they cannot use Private (on-prem) — their procurement forbids new infra. They demand BYO-KMS or HSM integration in hosted mode, which we currently don't support. That is the real deal-breaker.

Jared (SE): Technical options we have: 1) Short-term: hosted with envelope encryption + attestation (their keys not held by us). Not full BYO-KMS, but may be acceptable to some customers. 2) Shielded proxy: the customer holds keys on-prem and proxies decrypt/encrypt to our hosted endpoint — prototypeable. 3) Private/Dedicated with BYO-KMS (full support) but rollout ~4–6 weeks.

Priya (Solutions): If we pitch the shielded-proxy as an interim, engineering needs a 24h prototype to prove TLS+proxy path. That buys time for legal + revops.

Jared (SE): I'll spin up a prototype tomorrow. Quick local test I ran to reproduce handshake: 

```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST' https://ingest.redwood-dev/helion/ws
# then tail the tls logs: sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/tls-helion.log
# error snippet: "tls: handshake failure from 10.1.5.22:443"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled a tiny prototype cluster `helion-proto-8812` for 2026-03-22T09:12Z (job id prod-proto-8812).

Liam (Sales Eng): For the exec-ready one-liner: "Helion requires BYO-KMS & enforced mTLS for websocket; short-term path: a hosted pilot with constrained key model or a 4–6 week Dedicated/private deployment. Pilot pricing: ~20% of list for 2 weeks; Dedicated estimate ~$28k/mo."

Maya (AE): Good — I'm prepping a 3-slide brief for 15:00 PT call. @Taylor can you confirm the $6k credit now so I can include it? Also need legal to confirm if we can draft a one-off SOW addendum for the BYO-KMS exception.

Taylor (CSM): Confirmed — I have verbal sign-off for up to $6k pilot credit. I'll open the ticket and attach the approval.

Anika (Legal): I can draft a short SOW addendum for an interim BYO-KMS proxy approach, but I need exact wording on what we will and won't take responsibility for. Give me 48 hours for review. Also need to see the security questionnaire answers they provided.

Maya (AE): Copy — attaching link to internal runbook and the SQ: https://redwood.internal/poc-runbook/PR-342 & https://redwood.internal/security/helion-sq-answers.

Priya (Solutions): Next steps summary for the thread:
- Jared: prototype shielded-proxy (24–48h)
- Taylor: attach pilot credit ticket ($6k)
- Anika: SOW addendum draft (48h)
- Liam: escalate pricing to revops for written approval if needed
- Maya: prep slides for 15:00 PT exec call

Maya (AE): Thanks team. If we can get a working prototype + legal note by EOD tomorrow we should be able to keep Helion engaged and avoid escalation to procurement. :thumbsup:
